name: acme-example-orders
description: Acme Example Orders (mock served from its OpenAPI document)

settings.name: status_code
settings.description: Answer every call that reaches an operation with this HTTP status; 0 turns it off. Values from 1 to 199 are not final statuses and act as 0.

settings.name: delay_ms
settings.description: Wait this many milliseconds before answering any call; 0 turns it off.

settings.name: fail_rate
settings.description: The share of calls, from 0 to 1, answered 503 and recorded as fault.injected; 0 turns it off.

settings.name: operation_status.list_orders
settings.description: Answer GET /orders (operationId listOrders) with this HTTP status; 0 turns it off. It wins over status_code.

settings.name: operation_status.create_order
settings.description: Answer POST /orders (operationId createOrder) with this HTTP status; 0 turns it off. It wins over status_code.

settings.name: operation_status.get_order
settings.description: Answer GET /orders/{orderId} (operationId getOrder) with this HTTP status; 0 turns it off. It wins over status_code.
